title: Balochistan Ground Water Rights Administration Amendment Ordinance 2000

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Ground Water Rights Administration Amendment Ordinance 2000
sections.description:
Short title and Commencement

ORDINANCE IX OF 2000
BALOCHISTAN GROUND
WATER RIGHTS ADMINISTRATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE IX OF 2000
An Ordinance
further to amend the Balochistan Ground Water Rights Administration Ordinance,
1978
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 17th November, 2000]
No. Legis. 1-47/Law/71-VII,
dated 17-11-2000.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 13th November, 2000, is hereby published for general
information:--
1. Short title and
Commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Ground
Water Rights Administration (Amendment) Ordinance, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Ground Water Rights Administration Amendment Ordinance 2000
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3 of Ordinance IX of 1978

ORDINANCE IX OF 2000
BALOCHISTAN GROUND
WATER RIGHTS ADMINISTRATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE IX OF 2000
An Ordinance
further to amend the Balochistan Ground Water Rights Administration Ordinance,
1978
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 17th November, 2000]
No. Legis. 1-47/Law/71-VII,
dated 17-11-2000.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 13th November, 2000, is hereby published for general
information:--
2. Amendment of section 3 of
Ordinance IX of 1978.--In the Balochistan Ground Water Rights
Administration Ordinance, 1978, after clause (k) of subsection (6) of section
3, the following new clause shall be added, namely:-
"(1) The Board will arrange
to determine the existing withdrawal of ground water through the tubewells,
open surface wells, persian wells, karezes or any other means, by installation
of water meters, or any other water measuring devices, on the sources. "
